title: The Watching Eye
description: A surreal scene set in a 1950s kitchen where two women sit at a table drinking coffee under a hanging lamp. A large torn notebook page dominates the left and center, displaying a crude blue ink drawing of a bald, stitched, wide-eyed figure with a jagged mouth, while a massive bloodshot red eye with a purple iris floats above, casting a red glow.
prompt: Surreal horror scene in a retro 1950s kitchen with two women sitting at a Formica table drinking coffee. A giant torn notebook page floats in the foreground showing a crude childlike blue ink drawing of a bald stitched monster with empty circular eyes and jagged teeth. A massive glowing bloodshot red eye with purple iris hovers above the drawing emitting red light, vintage television sets in background showing static, hanging pendant lamp, unsettling atmosphere, detailed painting style
